vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled() that can disable the automatic liquidity addition mechanism. When disabled, fees accumulate in the contract but aren't automatically processed to liquidity. The owner is excluded from fees, so they can trade without paying fees while regular users would still incur fees that don't get processed. This gives the owner an unfair advantage.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the automatic swap and liquify mechanism.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Find the current owner address of the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) on the target contract. 4. Verify that swapAndLiquifyEnabled is now false.
